name: dev.ucp.shopping.item_inputs
title: Item Inputs Extension
description: Extends Catalog, Cart, Checkout, and Order with the information a Business needs from the buyer to make or prepare an item: a Business declares `item_inputs` on a variant, a Platform answers them with `item_input_values` on a line, and the Order preserves the answers.

variant_item_inputs.title: Variant Item Inputs
variant_item_inputs.description: The item input fields added to a catalog variant.

item_inputs.description: The information this variant needs from the buyer, in the order the Business wants it asked. Absent when the variant needs none.

item_inputs_variant.description: A catalog variant carrying item inputs.

item_inputs_lookup_variant.description: A lookup variant (carrying input correlation) carrying item inputs.

item_inputs_product.description: A catalog product whose variants carry item inputs. Used by search.

item_inputs_lookup_product.description: A lookup product whose variants carry item inputs, preserving input correlation. Used by lookup.

item_inputs_detail_product.description: A get_product detail product whose variants carry item inputs. Used by get_product.

line_item.title: Line Item with Item Inputs
line_item.description: Line item extended with the information its variant needs from the buyer and the answers supplied.

item_inputs.description: The information this line needs from the buyer, as the Business evaluates it for this cart or checkout. Absent when the line needs none.

item_input_values.description: The buyer's answers for this line, at most one per input. One set of answers applies to every unit on the line. A Platform writes the complete set; an input with no entry is unanswered.

order_line_item.title: Order Line Item with Item Inputs
order_line_item.description: Order line extended with the answers the buyer supplied for it.

item_input_values.description: The answers the buyer supplied for this line, as they stood at checkout: a historical record, unchanged if the catalog later changes. Absent when none were supplied.

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search.description: Catalog search composition with item inputs (extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search).

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup.description: Catalog lookup composition with item inputs (extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup).

dev.ucp.shopping.cart.title: Cart with Item Inputs
dev.ucp.shopping.cart.description: Cart extended so each line can carry the inputs its variant needs and the buyer's answers.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.title: Checkout with Item Inputs
dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Checkout extended so each line can carry the inputs its variant needs and the buyer's answers.

dev.ucp.shopping.order.title: Order with Item Inputs
dev.ucp.shopping.order.description: Order extended so each line preserves the answers the buyer supplied for it.
